en.title: Tournament Registration Process
en.excerpt: Guide for athletes on discovering sanctioned tournaments, selecting divisions, and completing instant digital checkout.
en.content:
Finding Tournaments on Archeris

Browse open tournaments by navigating to archeris.net/tournaments. Use search and filter tools to find events by city, date, or host club.

Choosing the Correct Category

Click on the tournament card to open the event overview. Select your competitive division (e.g., Recurve Men Senior 70m). Ensure your bow specifications and age qualify for the division rules.

Completing Online Payment

Click Register Now. Select your preferred payment method (QRIS or Virtual Account) and complete the transfer within the invoice time limit.

Accessing Your Digital Event Pass

Once verified, your entry appears under My Tournaments in your Archer Dashboard, providing access to your digital event pass and check-in barcode.
